name: An Arpeggio from One Note
description: A sampler plays one plucked note at four pitches, with up to eight voices at a time, through a reverb until you stop the run. Runs locally with no file, model or key.

data.comment:
# An Arpeggio from One Note

One recorded note becomes a melody that plays live, until you stop the run. Every step runs in the editor process, with no file, model or key.

**How it works:** "1 Note" is a Code node that writes one plucked note. "2 Clock" is a Gate with four rising edges for each second. Each edge starts a voice of "4 Sampler". The voice reads the pitch from "3 Steps" at that moment and keeps it. "3 Steps" is a triangle LFO of one cycle for each second, so the four notes are the root, the fifth, the ninth and the fifth. A note lasts longer than the time to the next one, so several voices at different pitches sound together. "5 Room" adds a reverb.

**Try this:** Set Voices on "4 Sampler" to 1: each note then cuts the note before it. Set Depth and Offset on "3 Steps" to 1 for octave steps, or set Tune on "4 Sampler" to -12.
